purpose: Establish the minimum physical-state and constitutive requirements before any RossFast unsaturated-to-saturated trajectory is implemented.
precommitted_questions: Is water content theta a one-to-one physical state coordinate once h reaches or exceeds zero?
Does saturated pressure head retain a physical degree of freedom even where theta and K have reached their saturated plateaus?
Is the already qualified C1R table sufficient up to the saturation boundary, or is there an unqualified near-saturation interval between its h=-1 cm upper envelope and h=0?
What minimum state information must survive checkpoint, rollback and restart for a cell that can become saturated?

frozen_constitutive_semantics.effective_saturation: For the base MvG fixture, S(h)=1 for h>=0 and S(h)=(1+|alpha*h|^n)^(-m) for h<0, m=1-1/n.
frozen_constitutive_semantics.conductivity: K(h)=KSATFIT when S>=1; otherwise the frozen base Mualem-VG closure used by C1R.
frozen_constitutive_semantics.inverse_convention: h(S=1)=0 is only a boundary convention; it cannot reconstruct arbitrary positive saturated pressure head from theta=theta_s.

state_admission_rule.minimum_requirement: Any cell that may be saturated must retain a pressure-head degree of freedom either directly as unified head state or explicitly within a mixed Ross state plus mode information.
state_admission_rule.unified_head_state: remains candidate, not selected by E0
state_admission_rule.mixed_Ross_state: remains candidate, not selected by E0
state_admission_rule.selection_rule: Do not choose between unified-head and mixed-state layouts on presumed performance. A later E1 transition-conservation gate must prove physical equivalence, exact storage accounting, deterministic mode switching and bounded cost.

mass_and_transaction_rules: No saturation mode switch may add or remove water outside the ordinary cell storage ledger.
A trial that discovers an unsupported saturation state must fail or fallback without mutating committed state.
Pressure head retained for a saturated cell is physical state, not solver scratch.
Constitutive intermediates, Jacobians and trial mode masks remain worker scratch until commit.
explicit_nonclaims: E0 does not qualify the near-saturation face flux from h=-1 to 0 cm.
E0 does not qualify saturated-saturated or saturated-unsaturated face response.
E0 does not choose unified-head versus mixed-Ross production storage.
E0 does not qualify saturation-transition timesteps, groundwater, prescribed-head bottom boundaries or heterogeneity.
E0 does not extend C1R by extrapolation above h=-1 cm.
